task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
answer: iPhone 12 IS compatible with iOS 17. Verified on Apple Support's 'iPhone models compatible with iOS 17' page (https://support.apple.com/en-cn/guide/iphone/iphe3fa5df43/17.0/ios), where iPhone 12 (along with iPhone 12 mini, 12 Pro, and 12 Pro Max) is listed among supported models. iOS 17 new features researched on Apple Support's 'What's new in iOS 17' page (https://support.apple.com/en-cn/guide/iphone/iphfed2c4091/17.0/ios) include: StandBy (待机显示), interactive widgets (互动小组件), Contact Posters, Live Voicemail (实时语音信箱), Stickers (贴纸), Journal, Messages Check In (平安确认), keyboard autocorrect improvements (自动纠正), FaceTime video messages, AirDrop/NameDrop, and offline Maps (离线地图).
